Package org.codehaus.mojo.versions.rule

Class RulesServiceBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.versions.rule.RulesServiceBuilder
public class RulesServiceBuilder extends Object
Builder for creating a RuleService instance.

The builder allows configuring the source of rules (inline RuleSet, a URI, or a classpath resource), the server id for remote access, ignored versions and other optional runtime elements such as the Log and MavenSession.

    • withDependabotConfig

      public RulesServiceBuilder withDependabotConfig(String dependabotConfig)
      Configure a Dependabot configuration file whose ignore entries are added to the resulting rules. A relative path is resolved against the multi-module project directory (the reactor root), not the current module.
      Parameters:
      dependabotConfig - path of the Dependabot configuration file, or null for none
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      2.25.0

    • withDependabotTargetBranch

      public RulesServiceBuilder withDependabotTargetBranch(String dependabotTargetBranch)
      Configure the target-branch whose Dependabot entries apply. When null, the branch checked out in the git working tree holding the Dependabot configuration file is used.
      Parameters:
      dependabotTargetBranch - the branch name, or null to detect it
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      2.25.0
